step1.title: Free consultation
step1.text: Tell the smart advisor what you are building; quantities, weights and project cost are calculated from real, current prices.

step2.title: Official proforma invoice
step2.text: Submit your inquiry cart. If every item in it has a published price, an official proforma — transparent pricing, a stated validity period — is issued and sent to you by SMS immediately. If any item’s price is not published, your request is filed and a specialist calls you with a quote.

step3.title: Assured supply
step3.text: Official sourcing from the Iran Mercantile Exchange and the mills; for bulk orders we open a letter of credit (LC) so a large transaction stays secure.

step4.title: Scheduled delivery
step4.text: The delivery window for every item is stated up front, and a human specialist stays with you until the load is unloaded.

why.title: Why Ahantime?
why.lead: Across {sku} priced products from {factory} mills, Ahantime does more than publish prices: consultation, an official proforma, managed storage and project-level calculators are all in the same place.

ai.title: A smart advisor with memory
ai.text: Ahantime's AI assistant answers from this site's real prices, remembers your conversation, and applies our specialists' corrections to later answers.

proforma.title: Official proforma, LC-backed supply
proforma.text: Submit your inquiry cart: as long as every item has a published price, the official proforma is sent by SMS straight away — otherwise a specialist calls you with a quote. Sourced through the Iran Mercantile Exchange and the mills, with a letter of credit (LC) available for bulk orders.

clients.title: Chosen by major industry
clients.text: Cement, oil refining, power generation and petrochemicals: Ahantime is used for corporate procurement and large projects, not only small orders.

warehouse.title: Customer warehouse
warehouse.text: Buy at today's price and leave the goods with us: storage at a stated monthly fee, optional cargo insurance, a contract and periodic settlement — with no warehouse of your own required.

tools.title: Free calculation tools
tools.text: Weight calculator, project estimator, cost calculator and a live gold and currency board: we do the project arithmetic here, not just list prices.

services.title: Dedicated B2B services
services.text: Tender estimation against live prices, order tracking, cut-to-size goods and managed storage — services a price-listing site does not provide.

about.title: Consult first, then buy
about.lead: {org} is an online marketplace for iron and steel prices and supply — where buying structural steel is done with transparent information and proper advice instead of guesswork.
about.storyP1: Iran's iron and steel market has struggled for years with sharp price swings, layers of middlemen and scattered information. Whether a contractor or an individual builder, the buyer usually decides without a clear picture of the real price or the quality of the goods.
about.storyP2: We built Ahantime to make that path transparent: prices that are live and dependable, advice available to everyone before they buy, and direct mill sourcing with no chain of intermediaries. Our motto is a commitment — “Consult first, then buy”.
about.whyLead: We removed the middleman, made pricing transparent and put advice within reach before the purchase, so you can decide with confidence.
about.howBody: There is no online payment at Ahantime. You add the products you want to an inquiry cart and receive a proforma invoice; our specialists then call you to confirm the price, availability and delivery time. That means you get to consult and be sure before any payment.

noMiddleman.title: Better prices, no middleman
noMiddleman.desc: Buying direct from the mill shortens the broker chain: the same goods, at a fairer price.

fast.title: Faster — 24-hour delivery
fast.desc: Agile transport and loading coordination; for most high-demand sections, delivery within 24 hours.

ai.title: AI advisor
ai.desc: Ahantime's smart assistant answers before you buy: size and grade selection, weight and cost estimates.

transparent.title: Transparent, current prices
transparent.desc: Prices update live, and the movement, bar weight and delivery time are stated next to every item.

direct.title: Direct mill sourcing
direct.desc: We guarantee authenticity and standard quality by sourcing directly from the producer.

support.title: Real human support
support.desc: Our specialists call you to finalise the proforma, availability and delivery — a real person, not a bot.

bourse.title: Purchasing via the commodity exchange
bourse.desc: Official sourcing through the Iran Mercantile Exchange: transparent pricing, a valid invoice and guaranteed product authenticity.

lc.title: Letters of credit for customers
lc.desc: For bulk purchases we open a letter of credit (LC) so your large transaction stays secure and worry-free.
